technical_data.user_awareness_training_note: This email uses AI to generate contextual details (recipient name, plausible IP address, realistic time of event) and subtle URL obfuscation to trick users into clicking malicious links.

indicators.dkim_pass_spf_fail: DKIM pass for micr0soft-support.com but DMARC fails due to mismatch with microsoft.com

examples.detection_method: Deploy advanced email security gateways with AI-powered URL and domain reputation analysis that detect homograph and subdomain obfuscation. Use natural language processing to identify AI-generated text patterns inconsistent with normal corporate communications. Monitor DMARC failures despite passing SPF/DKIM on lookalike domains. User awareness training with real examples of AI-spear phishing enhances detection and reporting.
